name: HTML Preview Anywhere
description: Render HTML source found on any page (code blocks, pasted markup, .html links, GitLab blobs & diffs) in an isolated sandbox. Toggle per site from the toolbar icon.

action.default_title: HTML Preview Anywhere — toggle on this site

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' https: http:; child-src 'self' https: http: data: blob:; object-src 'none';
